verdict.rationale: Check is a payroll and tax API platform with embeddable components, not an AI agent or client that consumes tools. Plugging external MCP servers into it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows Check publishes its own MCP server for clients like Claude and Cursor to connect to, which is the server role and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
